prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: a bowl of day-old rice, a bowl of leftover beans, one egg — one second still. Then motion: garlic and bacon bits crisping in a wide pan, the rice and beans tumbled in together and pressed flat, crackling as a crust forms underneath. Money shot: a section lifted to reveal a golden crispy crust, then a fried egg slid on top, the yolk pierced and flooding gold over the crisped rice in macro, backlit. Final beat: a spoon scraping up crust and yolk together. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the pressing crackle, then the yolk break. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: o mais brasileiro de todos — virado rápido de frigideira com ovo por cima. Sobra de ontem, orgulho de hoje. **Sábado que vem: [A] macarrão, molho de tomate e mussarela ou [B] abobrinha, ovo e queijo? Comenta A ou B 👇**
